build_tree_predict: build a python module to create a BART Tree and generate predictions from a covariate tensor
create_tree_growable_leaves: create a function that finds all growable leaf nodes in a BART Tree given input data
test_tree_mutate: test the Tree class mutate method by applying a GrowMutation or PruneMutation to the tree structure
review_tree_prunable_nodes: review the Tree class prunable_split_nodes method to find decision nodes with two leaf children
summarize_tree_structure: summarize the Tree class num_nodes and split_nodes methods to inspect overall tree structure
